irregularities.title: 'Justin Jefferson' is listed under conflicting clubs
irregularities.detail: Sources disagree about which club 'Justin Jefferson' belongs to (CLE, MIN). This is usually an upstream data error (wrong club attached to a player record) and must be reviewed before the row is trusted. No club was assigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: 7 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: 6 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: rapsheet.bsky.social said OUT for Jaxson Dart (official: see link); tompelissero.bsky.social said OUT for Jayden Daniels (official: see link); tompelissero.bsky.social said OUT for Sam Darnold (official: see link); RotoWire said OUT for Mason Taylor (official: see link); Tom Silverstein said QUESTIONABLE for Anthony Campbell (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
